title: docs: complete DX_ROADMAP Phase 1 & Phase 3 documentation
body:
Completes all actionable documentation items from DX_ROADMAP.md — Phase 1 (8/10) and Phase 3 (16/16, was 10/16).

### Phase 3: 13 new MDX pages

- **Protocol architecture**: `references/data/protocol-diagram.mdx` — Mermaid diagrams of all 7 protocol layers and request flow
- **Wire format**: `references/api/wire-format.mdx` — JSON request/response for 8 API operations
- **Contracts docs** (was empty `pages: []`): 6 pages covering `IMetadataService`, `IAuthService`, `IStorageService`, `IDataEngine`, `ICacheService` + overview index
- **Field type decision tree**: `references/data/field-type-decision-tree.mdx` — Mermaid flowchart mapping use cases → field types
- **Error handling guides**: `guides/error-handling-client.mdx` (React/TS patterns), `guides/error-handling-server.mdx` (hooks, transactions, safeParsePretty)
- **Data flow diagrams**: `guides/data-flow.mdx` — 7 sequence diagrams (config→boot, read, write, metadata, realtime)
- **Security permissions matrix**: `references/security/permissions-matrix.mdx` — CRUD × Profile matrix, FLS, sharing rules, OWD, role hierarchy

### Phase 1: Onboarding improvements

- StackBlitz "Try Online" badge on `packages/spec/README.md`
- Prerequisites section + common setup issues in `getting-started/index.mdx`
- Enhanced "How to Run" with expected output in all 4 example READMEs

### Navigation

Updated 6 `meta.json` files: contracts (was empty), data, api, security, guides, references (added `contracts` entry).

### DX_ROADMAP.md

Updated checklists, timeline, DX assessment scores. Remaining Phase 1 items (CLI wizard, video) are external/tooling scope.

All 194 test files / 5,243 tests pass unchanged.
